## Episode Thesis

Nordea's chief strategist Marie Giertz says the market is nervous but the fundamentals are solid: the economy is strong and companies are earning very well. Because prices have fallen while earnings kept rising, she thinks the autumn tech/AI sell-off has opened up 'a bit of a buying opportunity', though volatility will continue. She recommends broad index exposure, with Swedish equities (industrials and banks) as a way to diversify away from heavy tech concentration. On rates, she expects one more Riksbank hike, in February; Fed hikes look likely. The krona could strengthen as fiscal worries in Europe grow.
